name: Real Time Single Scattering Effects
definition: A real-time algorithm for rendering participating media that computes direct single scattering, indirect single scattering, and volumetric shadows using shadow volumes and spatial coherence, implemented via simple shaders and stencil buffer.
summary: Real Time Single Scattering Effects is a hardware-accelerated method that renders direct, indirect, and volumetric shadows in participating media using precomputed 2D lookup tables and stencil buffers.
